name: burst
workload: PHASE_16_PLAN.md section 5.1's burst profile at the scale kind carries, with the calibrated autoscaler free between its floor and the run's count (P16-TSK-015, E75; CAPACITY_MODEL.md section 4a): W2's shape, three times the rate for 60 s every ten minutes for an hour, the mix at a third of E30's step 3 (0.1302 of the target's peak) and each burst at that step (0.3906, carried within every objective at three replicas), with sign-ins in each burst at three times the target's sign-in peak, CPU-bound by the credential hash (68 ms of a replica's core each), so that every burst takes three replicas to about 114% of their CPU request, above the autoscaler's 70%, for its 60 s; a burst the standing fleet carries must not scale it, and no per-source limit may refuse the bursts' sign-ins

operations.name: bnpl
operations.reason: a BNPL purchase rests on a credit approval, and on kind none is possible, automatic or by a person: every credit policy's exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, no kind deployment can configure a bureau (the application refuses one until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved question 13 is answered), so the exposure is unassessed and the policy's fallback declines or refers (INV-CRD-10), and a person's approval of a referral is refused while it is (credit.ExposureUnassessable, INV-CRD-09); a simulated bureau on kind is an application change, and the owner decided on 2026-11-13 that none is built in Phase 16 (E20 rests on the recorded fail-safe); its instalments need its agreements

operations.name: lending
operations.reason: a repayment needs a disbursed loan, and a loan rests on a credit approval, and on kind none is possible, automatic or by a person: every credit policy's exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, no kind deployment can configure a bureau (the application refuses one until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved question 13 is answered), so the exposure is unassessed and the policy's fallback declines or refers (INV-CRD-10), and a person's approval of a referral is refused while it is (credit.ExposureUnassessable, INV-CRD-09); a simulated bureau on kind is an application change, and the owner decided on 2026-11-13 that none is built in Phase 16 (E20 rests on the recorded fail-safe)

operations.name: credit
operations.reason: a decision reads the bureau and financial data, neither configurable on kind (the application refuses either until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved questions 13 and 14 are answered), so every decision there is the fail-safe path, waiting its 30-minute collection window and referring (INV-CRD-10), which is E20's subject and not the target's decision; a decision with data needs a simulated bureau on kind, an application change, and the owner decided on 2026-11-13 that none is built in Phase 16
